# Chiltern & Thames Chauffeurs

> Pre-booked private Mercedes chauffeur transfers between Heathrow Terminals 2–5 and Maidenhead SL6, Henley-on-Thames RG9 and Oxford OX1–OX4.

- Book by phone only, 24/7, on 01628 773811 (+44 1628 773811).
- 24/7 incoming flight tracking, no deposit and free cancellation with 24+ hours’ notice.
- Ask by phone about inside Arrivals Meet & Greet or an agreed short-stay pickup.
- Prices are minimum guide fares. Confirm the journey fare and any terminal parking or drop-off fees by phone before booking.

## Routes

- [Heathrow corridor hub](https://pages.dev/)
- [Maidenhead SL6 → Heathrow T2–T5](https://pages.dev/maidenhead-sl6-to-heathrow)
- [Heathrow T2–T5 → Maidenhead SL6](https://pages.dev/heathrow-to-maidenhead-sl6)
- [Henley-on-Thames RG9 → Heathrow T2–T5](https://pages.dev/henley-on-thames-to-heathrow)
- [Heathrow T2–T5 → Henley-on-Thames RG9](https://pages.dev/heathrow-to-henley-on-thames)
- [Oxford OX1–OX4 → Heathrow T2–T5](https://pages.dev/oxford-to-heathrow)
- [Heathrow T2–T5 → Oxford OX1–OX4](https://pages.dev/heathrow-to-oxford)

## Mercedes fleet

- Mercedes E-Class, up to 4 passengers, minimum guide fare from £60.
- Mercedes S-Class, up to 4 passengers, minimum guide fare from £75.
- Mercedes V-Class, up to 6 passengers, minimum guide fare from £85.
